facts: Skylake is the codename used by Intel for a processor microarchitecture.
Skylake uses the same 14 nm manufacturing process technology as its predecessor.
Skylake serves as a "tock" in Intel's "tick-tock" manufacturing and design model.
According to Intel, the Skylake redesign brings greater CPU and GPU performance.
According to Intel, the Skylake redesign brings reduced power consumption.
Skylake CPUs share microarchitecture with Kaby Lake CPUs.
Skylake CPUs share microarchitecture with Cannon Lake CPUs.
Skylake is the last Intel platform on which Windows earlier than Windows 10 will be officially supported by Microsoft.
Enthusiast-created modifications exist that allow Windows 8.1 and earlier to continue to receive updates on later platforms.
Some processors based on the Skylake microarchitecture are marketed as "6th-generation Core".
On October 8, 2018, Intel announced new 9th gen Core X 98xx/99xx series CPUs.
The Core i9-9980XE Extreme Edition led the launch.
